messages:
Zoe (Docs): Quick heads-up  I spotted 3 broken anchors and an outdated autoscale example in the Dedicated provisioning doc. Opening a focused PR to patch links + swap snippets. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4901
Harper (ENG): which fields are stale? can you paste the old vs new so we can QA?
Zoe (Docs): Old example uses `policy.v1` and `tenant_id`. New schema expects `policies_v2` (array) and `tenant_label`. Also the Python SDK example still calls `allocate_pool()` instead of `reserve_pool()` which now returns `{ id }`.
Vik (Infra): dropping a very compact YAML for the handbook (keep under 25 lines):
Vik (Infra): ```yaml
annotations:
  redwood.com/isolation: "reserved:tenant"
policies_v2:
  - id: default
    min_replicas: 1
    max_replicas: 4
```
Lena (ML): tiny content note: the "quantization" paragraph links to an old benchmark. Suggest replacing with: "Adopt per-workload quant profiles; run a small perf vs quality sweep before rolling out cluster-wide." One short sentence.
Harper (ENG): good call. Also can we add a short migration snippet showing old->new payloads (2 small YAML blocks)? helps users copy/paste.
Zoe (Docs): yes — I'll add an explicit "Migration notes" section with side-by-side examples (3-5 lines each) and a one-liner at the top: "Breaking: policy.v1 -> policies_v2; allocate_pool() -> reserve_pool()."
Vik (Infra): on eviction precedence, recommend a tiny 2-bullet list under "Isolation":
Vik (Infra): - reserved pools: prioritized, not preempted by shared/burst
Vik (Infra): - shared/burst: may be preempted under capacity pressure
Zoe (Docs): perfect. I'll link to the isolation runbook for details: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/isolation-handbook (internal)
Lena (ML): also add one sentence under "Performance notes" about prefix caching vs full KV and tail latency tradeoffs. I'll draft it and paste into the PR.
Harper (ENG): CI ask: can we add a docs-only workflow to run link-checks and a small markdown schema lint for the autoscale snippet? keeps regressions at bay.
gardener-bot: lint: markdown anchors OK on branch zoe/dedicated-compact-fix :white_check_mark:
Zoe (Docs): plan: 1) fix anchors, 2) replace autoscale YAML with Vik's compact snippet, 3) update Python SDK to use `reserve_pool()` and show `{ id }` return, 4) add migration note + tiny side-by-side examples, 5) SLA wording tweak (clarify in-region only) + short example scenario, 6) add the link-check CI job. ETA: EOD, will ping reviewers when green. :sparkles:
